## Towed Array Data

-   **Encounter Information:** Link to [AC_FKW_Encounters](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1BK5xezOtL3sSQy4PFtc8o3f1anFRbcDFygFNgcaz9RE/edit?usp=sharing){target="_blank"}

-   **Processed Data:** Stored `C:\FKW_Outputs`

-   **Copy of Blank Folder Structure Below:** Stored `\\PICCRPNAS\CRP2\McCullough\CRP_PC_TowedArray\_Blank_Folder_Setup`

Name the header folder for encounters with the AC_ID (Crusie#AC; ex. 1705067)

Setup folder structure for each encounter:

-   1_TDOA
    -   Data
        -   Raw_CrossCorrelogram
    -   Results
-   2_Extract-PG
    -   Data
        -   Extracted_tables
        -   Pamguard_database_sqlite3
    -   Results
-   3_Localize
    -   Data
        -   Crosscorrelograms
        -   GPSandPos_info
        -   Pamguard_detections
        -   Raw_GPSandArray_info
        -   TDOA_tracks
    -   Results
